description: Creates a nominal journal batch after returning an unconfirmed payload preview. Requires a valid routeToken issued for the matching action workflow. The token remains valid through lookup, preview and the permitted transaction. Placeholder tokens are invalid. A routeToken does not bypass preview or explicit-confirmation requirements. A call without confirmWrite: true returns confirmation_required and a payload preview. confirmWrite: true applies the previewed change after explicit confirmation. Passing preflight is not confirmation.

accountTransactions.description: Nominal journal account transaction lines. Debits and credits should balance.

acCode.description: Nominal account code, for example 400 or 800.

description.description: Line description, for example Sales or Expenses.

firstDetail.description: First detail text for this line.

procDate.description: Processing date for this transaction line.

secondDetail.description: Second detail text for this line.

bookTranTypeId.description: Book transaction type id. Nominal Journal Batch is usually 7.

companyName.description: Company context name, for example YOUR-COMPANY-NAME.

confirmWrite.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly confirms creating this Nominal Journal Batch.

connectionRef.description: Opaque Red connection reference returned by brc_confirm_company_connection. Pass this exact value on every later tool call when the MCP client rotates session ids (for example Vibe/Mistral). Keep reusing the same connectionRef after successful tool calls — do not start a new connection because a lookup returned empty or partial data. It is not an API key and does not contain credentials.

routeToken.description: Opaque routeToken from brc_route_request for this action workflow. Required for transactional tools. Routing permission only — does not replace preview-before-posting or confirmWrite.

name: brc_create_nominal_journal_batch
title: Create Nominal Journal Batch
